title: 可达性分析与三色标记：循环引用为什么能被回收
expected_output:
=== reachability analysis, GC Roots = [A] ===
    grey=A -> black
    grey=B -> black
    grey=C -> black
    grey=D -> black
    black(visited) = 4
    unreachable (white) = [E, F]
    cyclic pair E,F collected = true
    reference counting would keep E and F forever = true
=== same graph, add root E ===
    grey=A -> black
    grey=E -> black
    grey=B -> black
    grey=C -> black
    grey=F -> black
    grey=D -> black
    black(visited) = 6
    unreachable (white) = []
    nothing dead now = true
